correctness.rationale: The identity follows from explicit indicator conditioning. At fixed s2, maximize s3 by Lagrange multipliers and a second-order tangent-space restriction: at most two active masses occur, and a local maximum cannot contain two equal large masses. Boundaries reduce support. One-large/equal-small factorizations have strict negative signs for support two to four; the five-mass rational witness has s2=13/20, s3=41/80 and covariance 1/1600. Continuity transfers positive covariance to every greater finite support; uniform law supplies negative covariance. Standard-library exact checks independently enumerate sample pairs and verify formula, witnesses and factors. Finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: This resolves a natural discrete conditional sign question at the smallest nontrivial sample size: five is the smallest support allowing richness and missing probability mass to rise together in covariance. The exact threshold explains how heterogeneous fixed-size multinomial sampling can behave differently from the corresponding independent Poissonized occupancy model. This is a complete support-size possibility classification, not an arbitrary isolated example.
